name: Sardegna Turismo
verdict: The 'Sardegna' branding on the Cagliari front shirt is the tourism promotion of the Autonomous Region of Sardinia, run by its regional tourism department….
note: Proposed rating: serious. The link is the region's tourism department (its own brand on the shirt); the region is a public body of the Italian state (parent link, sourced by regione-sardegna-italian-republic), whose migration-control abuses are the record. Needs a maintainer to set the tier and review the why. Doppio Malto was split out into its own record on the 2026-27 kit.

why.text: The 'Sardegna' front brand is the tourism promotion of the Autonomous Region of Sardinia, an Italian region with special autonomy under article 116 of the Constitution. Italy's migration-control model has unlawfully detained migrants and asylum seekers in punitive conditions and obstructed humanitarian rescues at sea.
